author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
The role of Aragorn, son of Arathorn II, and heir to the Kingdom of Gondor, will be recast in the upcoming film, The Hunt for Gollum. No specific reason was given, however Viggo Mortensen, who played Aragorn in Peter Jackson's Lord of the Rings film trilogy, did express interest in returning. Andy Serkis, who played Gollum in trilogy and is set to direct this new film, has said casting is already underway for a new actor. In other news, the Dead by Daylight developers have spilled the secret into creating a hit live-service game: don't make a live-service game. Or at least, don't set out to make one, just make a game with a fun gameplay loop, and live-service elements can come later. And finally, we celebrate the anniversary of an oft-forgotten Star Wars game.

#IGN
title: Aragorn Actor Vigo Mortensen Not Returning for 'The Hunt for Gollum' - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description:
Morbid Metal is a hack-and-slash action roguelite where you play as the last AI, created by the mysterious Operator and trapped in a post-apocalyptic simulation. Switch seamlessly between three powerful characters – Flux, Ekku, and Vekta – at any point, whether you’re exploring vibrant ruined landscapes or mid-combat. Each character has a distinct fighting style and signature skills that you can chain together through shapeshifting for stylish and powerful combos. The more creative you are with your attack combos, the better style score you’ll get at the end of your run. 

This trailer spotlights Flux, who the developers describe as follows: "Flux is a lightning-fast, precision-focused killer designed to dominate single-target combat. Armed with razor-sharp skills and blink-speed mobility, Flux excels at surgical strikes, dodge counters, and execution-heavy play that rewards timing and mastery." 

Play over 10 hours of content in the Early Access release of Morbid Metal when it launch
title: Morbid Metal: Official 'Flux' Character Spotlight Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Welcome back to Next-Gen Console Watch! This week Daemon, Max, and Ryan peer into the future of gaming, only to see the same consoles we're playing today being used possibly years from now. With all models of the PlayStation 5 and Xbox having received several price hikes over the years, and with world events and economic factors keeping the prices of nearly all goods high, it looks like true next-generation gaming maybe delayed for the forseeable future. What can Sony do to bring costs down? And is this an opportunity for Xbox to gain relevance with gamers, now that the base PS5 and Xbox Series X are roughly the same price? Plus we have last week's poll results, and a new poll for you to vote on at IGN.com and Spotify.

#IGN #Gaming
title: Rising Prices Mean We’re Stuck with PS5, Series X - Next-Gen Console Watch

author: IGN
description:
If you want to survive the horrors of Bite by Night and look good doing it, you're going to need a mountain of Scrap. As the primary currency for unlocking new Animatronics, Survivors, and those elusive VIP passes, Scrap is the lifeblood of your progression. In this guide, we break down exactly how the Scrap cap works, why your role choice matters more than you think, and which Survivors you should unlock first to maximize your earnings per match.

Bite by Night is the latest asymmetrical horror hit on Roblox, and mastering its economy is key to reaching the endgame. Whether you're a new player stuck with the default Customer or a seasoned pro eyeing that 15,000 Scrap VIP Game Pass, these tips will help you optimize your grind. We cover the best farming methods, how to disable the Killer role to save time, and the specific actions like repairing generators and stunning Animatronics that boost your bank.
title: Bite by Night: How to Get Scrap Fast
